metadata.title: फ़र्जी आदिवासी प्रमाणपत्र से सरपंच बनीं | Fake Tribal Became Sarpanch
metadata.description:
A non-tribal woman elected as Sarpanch on a tribal-reserved seat in Chhattisgarh | Main Bhi Bharat
In Kanker district of Chhattisgarh, a serious case of identity fraud has come to light. Dhaneshwari Yadav, a woman from the OBC community, contested and won the election for Sarpanch on a seat reserved for Scheduled Tribes by falsely claiming tribal status. Villagers allege that her caste certificate was wrongly issued due to clerical errors, which were not verified properly by the administration. Now, the villagers are demanding her removal and a re-election, citing violation of constitutional rights of tribal communities. This report uncovers how such fake caste certificates are misused to grab reserved posts — from panchayats to parliament.
